ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a nitrogen-containing cyclic transition-state structure, with two curved arrows; according to the problem statement, these arrows are not counted in the structure. The alkene carbon on the right is connected to R1, and the alkene carbon above is connected to H; the ring continues through two carbons to a carbon at the lower left that is connected to both R and OH; the lower part inside the ring is N, and N is connected to R2. Reasoning: After ignoring the arrows, replace R1, R, and R2 all with the SMILES wildcard atom *. According to the specified writing method, take the alkene carbon on the right bearing R1 as the ring starting point, and use the prefixed * to represent the R1 wildcard substituent, obtaining *C1; then write the double bond to the upper alkene carbon as =C, then write two saturated carbons CC along the ring; when reaching the carbon connected to R and OH, write C(*)(O); then go through N to return to the starting point and write N1; finally, R2 on N is represented by the terminal wildcard atom *. Therefore the SMILES is *C1=CCC(*)(O)N1*.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: Inspect the image and discard the curved arrows as instructed. Replace R1, R, and R2 by wildcard atoms. Choose the right alkene carbon bearing R1 as the SMILES ring start, write the double bond to the upper alkene carbon, continue around the ring through the two saturated carbons to the carbon bearing both wildcard R and OH, then close through N back to the starting carbon, and finally attach the N wildcard substituent. This gives *C1=CCC(*)(O)N1*.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个含氮环状过渡态结构，带有两条弯曲箭头；按题意这些箭头不计入结构。右侧烯烃碳连接 R1，上方烯烃碳连接 H；环继续经过两个碳到达左下方一个同时连接 R 和 OH 的碳；环内下方是 N，N 上连接 R2。
推理：忽略箭头后，把 R1、R、R2 都替换为 SMILES 通配原子 *。按照指定写法，从右侧带 R1 的烯烃碳作为环起点，并用前置 * 表示 R1 通配取代基，得到 *C1；然后写与上方烯烃碳的双键 =C，再沿环写两个饱和碳 CC；到达连接 R 和 OH 的碳时写 C(*)(O)；然后经过 N 回到起点写 N1；最后 N 上的 R2 用末尾通配原子 * 表示。因此 SMILES 为 *C1=CCC(*)(O)N1*。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the straightforward graph-to-SMILES route: directly transcribe the displayed connectivity after discarding reaction arrows. For this problem, genuinely distinct alternatives are limited because the task is simply structural transcription.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the drawing as a five-membered ring containing one nitrogen. Identify the ring sequence as N–C bearing R and OH–C–C(H)=C bearing R1–back to N, with N also bearing R2. Ignore the curved arrows shown near the OH/N atoms.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard SMILES conventions: unlabeled skeletal vertices are carbons, R/R1/R2 generic substituents are represented as wildcard atoms '*', ring closure is marked with digit 1, '=' denotes the alkene, and OH/R substituents on the same ring carbon are written as branches.
